verdict.rationale: Rootly's API overview page offers a "Download OpenAPI Specification" link to https://rootly.com/swagger/v1/swagger.json, which developers can use to explore endpoints or generate client libraries. An API changelog tracks changes to that surface. The probe's 404s were on unrelated guessed paths under docs.rootly.com, so they do not contradict the documented spec URL. The swagger.json URL does return 403 to non-browser clients, which limits automated retrieval by agents. Missing for 10: reliable programmatic (non-browser) fetching of the spec, independent hands-on confirmation of the spec's completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Download the OpenAPI/Swagger specification to explore the Rootly API endpoints or generate client libraries.
